title: ficus populnea f. eupopulnea
intro: Ficus populnea f. eupopulnea, commonly known as the Banyan Fig, is a species of fig tree known for its unique habit of growing aerial roots that resemble a banyan tree. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Ficus populnea f. eupopulnea include reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues, while its therapeutic actions include acting as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Ficus populnea f. eupopulnea include flavonoids, tannins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
